newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks up on banks, Hansapank leads.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks up on banks, Hansapank leads.

text.p: Banking sector stocks remained good performers on the Estonian bourse on Thursday with Hansapank taking most of the trade in an active market, dealers said.
"It was expected that all banks would bring in good profits during January from the Latvian and Lithuanian bourses. So the results news has dominated trading, especially Hansapank," said one dealer.
Traders are now waiting for Tallinna Pank's result.
The Tallinn stock exchange index gained 1.71 percent to close at 195.26 on a turnover of 67 million kroons on the official list.
Hansapank completely dominated trade with turnover of 33.3 million kroons to close up one kroon at 183.00 after reaching a high of 190 kroons.
"Hanspank's January results were good and this has driven the market today," said one dealer.
Saving Bank was down 1.30 kroons to 92.15 after 8.0 million kroons of shares changed hands.
In other stocks, Union Bank turned over 6.2 million kroons of shares to finish at 41.20, up 0.85 kroons.
Tallinna Pharma was active with 5.2 million kroons of shares traded advancing 6.75 kroons to 116.00.
Forkespank gained 0.94 kroons to 153.6 on turnover of 3.9 million kroons.
On the over-the-counter market turnover came to 11.9 million kroons with most stocks making gains.
Norma plastics manufacturer was most active as it registered six million kroons of activity to close down 0.30 at 57.60 kroons.
Rakvere Meat plant saw trade of 4.2 million kroons and it eased 0.25 kroons to 15.40.
